# AP-10: ten primes in arithmetic progression, 513 digits

```
(463736765183 + 4328827402·n)·1193# + 1,   n = 0, 1, ..., 9
```

Ten primes in arithmetic progression, each with 513 digits. Here 1193# is the product of all primes up to 1193
(the primorial). The common difference is 4328827402·1193#.

- **Found:** 28 November 2026
- **Discoverer:** Arnav Garg ([arnavgarg.in](https://arnavgarg.in))
- **Proof:** all ten terms are proven prime. Each has an ECPP certificate in the format of [CM](https://www.multiprecision.org/cm/) by
  Andreas Enge, checked with its `ecpp-check` verifier, and an N−1 certificate.
- The terms for n = −1 and n = 10 are composite, so the progression has exactly ten terms.

On 28 November 2026, the largest AP-10 on Norman Luhn's
[list of records for primes in arithmetic progression](https://www.pzktupel.de/PAP/aprecords.php) (page updated 27 November 2026) was
a 512-digit AP-10 (Norman Luhn, 31 October 2024).

## Files

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `terms.txt` | all ten terms in decimal |
| `certificates/t<n>.ecpp.cert` | ECPP certificate of term n (CM format) |
| `certificates/t<n>.nminus1.txt` | N−1 certificate of term n: N, the factored part of N−1 and the witnesses |
| `certificates.zip` | the same 20 certificate files in one archive |
| `record.json` | the numbers above, for scripts |

## Checking it yourself

Probable-prime check of all terms, and that they form the progression (Python with gmpy2):

```python
import gmpy2
a, d, p = 463736765183, 4328827402, gmpy2.primorial(1193)
terms = [(a + d * n) * p + 1 for n in range(10)]
assert all(gmpy2.is_prime(t) for t in terms)
assert all(len(str(t)) == 513 for t in terms)
assert not gmpy2.is_prime((a - d) * p + 1) and not gmpy2.is_prime((a + 10 * d) * p + 1)
print("10 terms, 513 digits each, probable primes")
```

Proofs, with CM installed:

```
for n in $(seq 0 9); do ecpp-check -f certificates/t$n.ecpp.cert; done
```

Each run should print that the file contains a valid ECPP certificate in the CM format. The first number in each
certificate is the term it proves.
